additional_concerns: Both format claims are supported as statements that a method is listed, but not as exhaustive permission conditions. Footnote 3 is supplied and requires Hongkong Post e-Cert for XML and PDF submissions. The claims' assertions that it is missing are contradicted. If the extracted conditions are intended to be sufficient conditions, that stronger reading is not established.

XML use additionally requires following the separately provided JFIU XML schema and liaising to arrange a technical test (da12aecad4e68.u14.2439). The source does not expressly make successful completion of a test a prerequisite to every submission; adding that restriction would require support.

The prescribed PDF form and JFIU XML schema are missing. Neither can reliably be matched to the anonymous dependency IDs. They are necessary for detailed format-compliance assessment, but not for establishing that the circular lists these methods. The authority assessments below use the latter, claim-specific scope.

node.5d8c4ca625a46c41ff2f4098 includes all of 2 February 2026; the other candidates select the 9:00am launch boundary. The source's calendar-date channel rule and operational launch time leave competing readings of 'following its implementation'. These assessments do not resolve that difference. Authoritative clarification of the governing timezone and implementation boundary is missing and has no identifiable supplied dependency ID.

Urgent blackout contact is expressly permitted, but contact alone does not establish an actual submission. Conversely, a genuine submission should not be excluded merely because it involved direct contact. Automatic migration is separately described and does not itself establish a new submission.

node.29b224046d115582fbf223fb places actual submission in its result; the other event candidates place it in scope. Non-submission events can consequently produce FALSE versus OUT_OF_SCOPE. The intended event domain requires clarification before these outputs are treated as equivalent.

The history candidate delegates event existence and completeness to an externally supplied Boolean. Its formula does not inspect histories. The relationship between the responsible entity and the submitter of each historical event also requires factual assessment.

A later STREAMS 2 resubmission does not erase an original triggering event. TRUE_IS_SATISFIED must follow the typed DUTY_TRIGGER meaning; it does not establish discharge or an outstanding duty. No scoped label establishes overall correctness or authorizes pruning.
